hero.title: Central Tiffin Room: Bengaluru's Legendary Taste of Tradition
hero.subtitle: For over a century, Central Tiffin Room has delighted generations with iconic Dosas, Idlis, and timeless South Indian delicacies. Experience our rich heritage.

about.title: Our Legacy at Central Tiffin Room
about.paragraph1: Central Tiffin Room (CTR), also known as Central Tiffin Rooms, is a legendary establishment steeped deeply in the hearts and history of Old Bengaluru. Incepted in 1920, we have been delighting patrons for over a century with our iconic Dosas, Idlis, and a variety of South Indian delicacies, which have remained timeless favorites among people of all ages.
about.paragraph2: CTR’s rich legacy, crafted by the visionary Subramanyam brothers, Mr. Sanjeev Poojari, and continued by the current 3rd Generation baton carriers Mr. Sandesh Poojari and Ganesh S Poojari, epitomizes culinary mastery and cherished tradition in all its glory. If there’s one thing that mirrors the Central Tiffin Room brand, it is the sheer love of our patrons who have been showering us with boundless love and support for the last 100+ years.
